teacher_info.about_teacher: As a teacher I always try to figure out what each individual person needs to practice. That is why I like to have a simple conversation the first lesson and ask what the student wants to study and see what level they are in. I always try to make the lesson contents according to the students level. While teaching I always try to make sure my students speaks and expresses themselves as much as possible and I'll always encourage them and also fill in the blanks to give them a little push so they won't be stopping in the middle of the sentence.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I think studying from materials is very good but to improve a language, speaking is very important. That is why I encourage students to speak a lot.  During my lessons I use materials where we learn about new grammar and expressions but I also make sure to practice them verbally. I put a lot of focus on speaking since that is the most effective way of improving a language. Because I know from my own experience learning a language. Speaking is the key!

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL
pro_course_detail.description:
A TOEFL course is designed to prepare students for the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), which evaluates English language proficiency for non-native speakers. The course typically covers the four key sections of the exam:

1. Reading: Focuses on strategies to understand academic texts, improve reading speed, and answer comprehension questions.
2. Listening: Helps students develop skills to understand conversations and lectures, with practice in note-taking and answering related questions.
3. Speaking: Prepares students for the speaking section with practice in delivering clear, structured responses on various topics.
4. Writing: Guides students in writing well-organized essays, focusing on grammar, coherence, and argument development.

The course often includes practice tests, tips for managing time, and strategies for answering different question types to boost confidence and maximize scores.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
An IELTS course is designed to help students prepare for the **International English Language Testing System (IELTS) exam, focusing on improving skills in four main areas:

1. Listening: Practice with a variety of accents and real-life conversations to enhance listening comprehension.
2. Reading: Strategies to quickly understand and analyze academic and general texts, with a focus on answering comprehension questions accurately.
3. Writing: Training on writing structured essays and reports, focusing on grammar, coherence, and vocabulary.
4. Speaking: Practice sessions to build confidence in speaking fluently and coherently on a range of topics, including individual interviews.

The course includes mock tests, tips for managing time, and strategies to maximize scores in both the Academic and General Training versions of the exam.

Looking forward to working with you!

My lessons are structured and tailored to your specific needs. Together we will cover all areas of the language to help you reach fluency while learning many interesting things along the way! We will talk about psychology, food, science, music, technology and much more! We will be using different tools such as: books, flashcards, videos, songs and articles to sharpen your skills.

Looking forward to meeting you soon!

pro_course_detail.description:
Let's talk business!

Business English communication skills are essential for getting ahead at work. Improving your professional business vocabulary and knowledge will help you work more effectively and open up new career opportunities.

These lessons are specifically designed for professionals who are looking forward to growing professionally. The lessons cover a broad range of topics with many interactive activities to target all areas of the language in every aspect of work.

pro_course_detail.title: General English - Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In this section you will find a wide range of reading, listening and language practice activities for all levels from beginner (CEFR level A1) to advanced (CEFR level C1). We will learn with videos, audios, articles and stories.

You will improve your knowledge of everyday English and the language you need for socialising. You will also develop your comprehension skills and build your vocabulary.
